definitions.explanation: A country other than one's own. Often used in writing, news, and formal speech as a slightly more abstract alternative to {外国|がいこく}.

examples.japanese: {他国|たこく}の{文化|ぶんか}を{学|まな}ぶ。
{他国|たこく}との{比較|ひかく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Comparison with other countries is necessary.

examples.japanese: {他国|たこく}の{制度|せいど}を{参考|さんこう}にして、{新|あたら}しい{法律|ほうりつ}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: Using other countries' systems as a reference, they created a new law.

notes:
Composed of {他|た} (other) + {国|こく} (country). More common in written and analytical contexts than in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {他国|たこく}の{文化|ぶんか}: other countries' cultures
- {他国|たこく}と{比|くら}べる: to compare with other countries
- {他国|たこく}{民|みん}: foreign nationals (literary)
- {他国|たこく}の{例|れい}を{参考|さんこう}にする: to use other countries' examples as reference

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外国|がいこく}: foreign country — the everyday word, neutral and common
- {異国|いこく}: foreign land — literary, suggests exoticism
- {自国|じこく}: one's own country — direct antonym
